text.title: Mobile Responsive Procedure
text.summary: 10-step procedure to apply Mobile Responsive end-to-end against a single input bundle. Each step has explicit input/action/output; gates between steps surface human-review points before binding actions.

step.name: container-query-policy
step.action: Decide where component queries apply; pin browser support floor.

step.name: touch-targets
step.action: Add lint rule (stylelint or test) asserting interactive elements meet 44px min.

step.name: viewport-meta
step.action: Add viewport meta to all entry templates; assert in e2e.

step.name: safe-area
step.action: Add safe-area envs to layouts touching edges.

step.name: hover-audit
step.action: Audit hover-only flows; add tap equivalents.

step.name: fluid-sizing-and-viewport-units
step.action: Replace fixed pixel widths with `min(100%, Npx)` or percentages and fixed type/spacing with `clamp()`. Replace every `100vh` with `100dvh` (or `svh`/`lvh` per intent), keeping a `100vh` line before it as the fallback.
step.decision-gate: If the fixed-px surface is large, migrate component by component — a half-finished sweep that leaves both conventions in one stylesheet is worse than either.

step.name: verification-gate
step.action: Run Playwright at 360 / 768 / 1280 / 1920, capture screenshots, assert no horizontal overflow, and run the Lighthouse mobile audit. Wire the run into CI.
step.output: screenshots + Lighthouse JSON + a merge gate
step.decision-gate: Block the merge on Lighthouse perf < 85, a11y < 95, or any horizontal scroll at any of the four widths.
